# Desire as production

The other picture: desire is not a hole but a factory. It does not lack its object; it makes connections, assembles things, builds a world in which the object means something.

## What this buys

On this reading there is nothing missing at the root of wanting. A person who wants to sail is not short of a boat; the wanting has already assembled the sea, the weather, the weekends and a version of themselves into one arrangement.

It also explains why wanting can be joyful rather than restless, which [[Desire as lack]] struggles with.
